items.name: match-card
items.title: Match Card
items.description: Compact match row with teams, score or kickoff time, status, and an optional odds row.

items.name: mrdoge-match-card-adapter
items.title: Match Card Adapter (Mr. Doge SDK)
items.description: Maps a real matches.get()/odds.list() response onto Match Card's props.

items.name: odds-selector
items.title: Odds Selector
items.description: Labeled odds card for a market: selectable options with price movement and suspended states.

items.name: mrdoge-odds-selector-adapter
items.title: Odds Selector Adapter (Mr. Doge SDK)
items.description: Pairs Over/Under markets into OddsLine[] and picks a representative line, for Odds Selector's lines prop.

items.name: bet-slip
items.title: Bet Slip
items.description: Panel for selected picks — single/parlay mode, optional stake input and computed potential payout.

items.name: mrdoge-bet-slip-adapter
items.title: Bet Slip Adapter (Mr. Doge SDK)
items.description: Builds a BetSlipPick from a real match, one of its markets, and a selected line id.

items.name: mrdoge-conflict-adapter
items.title: Conflict Adapter (Mr. Doge SDK)
items.description: Flags mutually incompatible picks (Match Result vs Double Chance, Over/Under threshold overlap, BTTS vs low Totals) for disabledIds or conflictingPickIds.

items.name: match-timeline
items.title: Match Timeline
items.description: Chronological feed of match events (goals, cards, substitutions).

items.name: ai-recommendation-card
items.title: AI Recommendation Card
items.description: AI-generated pick with confidence, edge, rationale, and risk factors.

items.name: region-accordion
items.title: Region Accordion
items.description: Collapsible region list, grouped by competition, with event counts.

items.name: live-indicator
items.title: Live Indicator
items.description: Status pill for a match: scheduled, live, paused, intermission, interrupted, or finished.

items.name: settlement-badge
items.title: Settlement Badge
items.description: Post-settlement outcome badge: won, lost, or push.

items.name: team-form-indicator
items.title: Team Form Indicator
items.description: Row of recent match results (W/D/L/U) for a team, with optional per-match tooltip detail.

items.name: sport-picker
items.title: Sport Picker
items.description: Icon-based sport filter.

items.name: entity-image
items.title: Entity Image
items.description: Team or region logo, unstyled — falls back to initials when the image is missing.

items.name: mrdoge-client
items.title: Mr. Doge Client
items.description: Browser SDK client singleton, authenticated via short-lived tokens minted by your own backend — never a raw API key.

items.name: mrdoge-token-route
items.title: Mr. Doge Token Route
items.description: Server route that mints short-lived SDK tokens for the browser client, using @mrdoge/node and your MRDOGE_ODDS_API_KEY.

items.name: use-live-match
items.title: useLiveMatch
items.description: Subscribes to a single match over WebSocket — score, status, and clock update in real time as the match progresses.

items.name: use-match
items.title: useMatch
items.description: One-shot fetch of a single match — no live updates, unlike useLiveMatch. Call again / remount to refresh.

items.name: use-live-odds
items.title: useLiveOdds
items.description: Subscribes to a single match's live odds over WebSocket (Business tier) — every matching market updates in place as odds change.

items.name: use-odds-movement
items.title: useOddsMovement
items.description: Diffs each bet item's price against its previous snapshot, so an Odds Selector can color a price green or red as live odds change.

items.name: use-trending-matches
items.title: useTrendingMatches
items.description: Today's most-viewed matches, ranked server-side by views. One-shot, not a subscription.

items.name: use-matches
items.title: useMatches
items.description: A plain list of matches, not limited to today's most-viewed ones. One-shot, not a subscription.
